source: Important. Routing formulation changes semantics, optimization, and execution. An alternative that balances loads perfectly may impose different constraints on token coverage, causality, batching, or implementation. “Balanced” is not sufficient to declare one router universally superior.
zh: 重要。路由制定改变了语义、优化和执行。完美平衡负载的替代方案可能会对令牌覆盖范围、因果关系、批处理或实现施加不同的约束。 “平衡”不足以宣告一款路由器具有普遍优越性。
